editor_note: The translation is faithful and won't mislead a learner. Caveats, conditions and quantities all carry over, including the disclaimer in [10], the 74/124 vs 128/186 qubit counts in [28] and the "at most one endpoint" constraint in [48], and terms like vincolo one-hot, XY-mixer and transpilazione stay consistent. There is one awkward calque: in [7], "constraint-native extension" becomes "un'estensione nativa dei vincoli". That reads as "a native extension of the constraints" rather than "an extension that handles constraints natively". A smaller stiffness is "il tuo ID del job" in [65].

examples.source: a constraint-native extension of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)
examples.translation: un'estensione nativa dei vincoli del Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)
examples.suggested: un'estensione del Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) che gestisce nativamente i vincoli
examples.why: Calque that attaches 'nativa' to the constraints, not the algorithm. It's ambiguous and unidiomatic, though the intended meaning is still recoverable.

examples.source: contact support@aqarios.com with your job ID
examples.translation: contatta support@aqarios.com indicando il tuo ID del job
examples.suggested: contatta support@aqarios.com indicando l'ID del tuo job
examples.why: 'il tuo ID del job' is a stiff word order. 'l'ID del tuo job' is the natural phrasing.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. The pre-flight checks, the backend methods and the circuit/application function descriptions all keep their meaning, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout. A native editor would still fix a few things. Entry [18] calques "Fail fast" as "Fallisci rapidamente", which reads oddly as an imperative. Entry [61] repeats "Plan" in "piano IBM Quantum Premium Plan". Entry [64] turns "hope to bring" into "preferiscono invece portare", which shifts the nuance from aspiration to preference. Entry [43] uses "incluso:" where "tra cui:" is the natural lead-in to a list.

examples.source: Fail fast in pipelines and notebooks instead of waiting in the queue.
examples.translation: Fallisci rapidamente in pipeline e notebook invece di attendere in coda.
examples.suggested: Ottieni subito un errore in pipeline e notebook invece di attendere in coda.
examples.why: 'Fallisci rapidamente' is a literal calque of 'fail fast' and sounds like telling the reader to fail. An Italian writer would describe getting the error early.

examples.source: for IBM Quantum Premium Plan users
examples.translation: per gli utenti del piano IBM Quantum Premium Plan
examples.suggested: per gli utenti del piano IBM Quantum Premium
examples.why: 'piano ... Plan' says 'plan' twice.

examples.source: and instead hope to bring their domain knowledge to advance quantum computing algorithms
examples.translation: e preferiscono invece portare la loro conoscenza del dominio
examples.suggested: e sperano invece di mettere a frutto la loro conoscenza del dominio
examples.why: 'hope' becomes 'prefer'. The claim changes slightly from an aspiration to a preference.

examples.source: including:
examples.translation: incluso:
examples.suggested: tra cui:
examples.why: 'incluso:' before a list is a calque. 'tra cui:' is the idiomatic Italian lead-in.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful and nothing here would mislead a learner. However, "Qiskit skills" is translated as "competenze Qiskit" in entries [0], [1], [3] and [5]. That sounds like human proficiencies, when the source means Qiskit's installable agent skills (github.com/Qiskit/skills), so Italian tech writing would keep "skill" as-is ("le skill Qiskit", "la skill migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime"). In entry [5], "è stata rilasciata, per migrare il codice" also copies the English comma-plus-purpose clause and reads stiffly.

examples.source: The `migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime` skill was released, for migrating `qiskit-ibm-runtime` code.
examples.translation: La competenza `migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime` è stata rilasciata, per migrare il codice `qiskit-ibm-runtime`.
examples.suggested: È stata rilasciata la skill `migrate-qiskit-ibm-runtime`, per la migrazione del codice `qiskit-ibm-runtime`.
examples.why: 'Competenza' suggests a human skill, but this is a named, installable agent skill that Italian tech prose keeps as 'skill'. The trailing comma-plus-purpose clause also copies the English structure.

examples.source: The latest updates from Qiskit skills, including the latest skills release and update summaries.
examples.translation: Gli ultimi aggiornamenti dalle competenze Qiskit, inclusi l'ultima release delle competenze e i riepiloghi degli aggiornamenti.
examples.suggested: Gli ultimi aggiornamenti delle skill Qiskit, inclusa l'ultima release e i riepiloghi degli aggiornamenti.
examples.why: Same product-name issue as entry [5]. 'dalle competenze' is also an awkward calque of 'from'.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally. "Transpiler passes" becomes "passaggi di transpilazione basati sull'IA", "release notes" becomes "note di rilascio" and the hedge "might be faster" keeps its meaning as "potrebbero essere più veloci". The informal "tu" form holds throughout ("Consulta", "visita", "Leggi").

The meaning is faithful all the way through: the beta caveat and the "qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.47.0 o superiore" requirement are kept, and the tu register is consistent ("preferisci", "consulta", "puoi"). In [6], "directed execution model" is rendered "modello di esecuzione diretta", which most Italian readers take as "direct execution" rather than execution the user steers. It is recognizable, not false. In [5], "presentate in anteprima per la prima volta" is redundant, a calque of "first previewed".

examples.source: which make up the [directed execution model]
examples.translation: costituiscono il [modello di esecuzione diretta]
examples.suggested: costituiscono il [modello di esecuzione guidata] (or keep "directed execution model" in English at first mention)
examples.why: 'esecuzione diretta' most naturally reads as 'direct execution'. It loses the sense that the user directs or controls how execution happens.

examples.source: both of which were first previewed at QDC 2025
examples.translation: entrambe presentate in anteprima per la prima volta al QDC 2025
examples.suggested: entrambe presentate in anteprima al QDC 2025
examples.why: 'in anteprima' already means a first showing, so 'per la prima volta' is redundant. It is a calque of 'first previewed'.

editor_note: Entry 5 is accurate and reads naturally. "Consigliamo di utilizzare queste versioni o versioni più recenti" keeps the "or newer" recommendation in full, and "sviluppato utilizzando i seguenti requisiti" matches the English with no drift.

Entry 21 is faithful and reads naturally. "Copia e salva il bearer token restituito" and "includendo il CRN e il bearer token negli header della richiesta" keep both required credentials, and "bearer token" is used the same way as in entry 20.

Entry 39's table is faithful: all figures, initializations and error values are unchanged, and the row labels ("Equazione di Burgers non viscosa", "Equazioni di Eulero senza pressione", "Test di trazione 1D ipoelastico") match the headings in entries 14, 44 and 47.

Neither rewritten card misleads; both descriptions say what the English says. The problem is that entries 12 and 13 leave their visible card text in English (title "Learning paths", linkText "Visit IBM Quantum Learning" and "Explore learning paths"). Every other card on the page translates these fields ("Avvio rapido", "Sfoglia i tutorial", "Scopri di più"), so these two stand out. In entry 13, "sequenze curate" is a calque; "percorsi selezionati" or "sequenze selezionate" reads more naturally, and "facilitare la conoscenza" is stiff.

examples.source: title="Learning paths" ... linkText="Explore learning paths"
examples.translation: title="Learning paths" ... linkText="Explore learning paths"
examples.suggested: title="Percorsi di apprendimento" ... linkText="Esplora i percorsi di apprendimento"

examples.source: linkText="Visit IBM Quantum Learning"
examples.translation: linkText="Visit IBM Quantum Learning"
examples.suggested: linkText="Visita IBM Quantum Learning"
examples.why: Only the product name should stay in English. The verb should be translated, as "Esplora" and "Trova" are on the other cards.

examples.source: Explore curated sequences of learning, documentation, and tutorial content designed to facilitate knowledge and skill-building
examples.translation: Esplora sequenze curate di contenuti di apprendimento, documentazione e tutorial pensate per facilitare la conoscenza e lo sviluppo di competenze
examples.suggested: Esplora sequenze selezionate di contenuti formativi, documentazione e tutorial, pensate per favorire l'acquisizione di conoscenze e lo sviluppo di competenze
examples.why: "Sequenze curate" is a calque of "curated", and "facilitare la conoscenza" is stiff Italian. The meaning is still correct.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful: [52] "macOS ARM64 (11.0 o successivo)" matches the source, and [55] "I sistemi operativi di Livello 2:" keeps the Tier→Livello choice used for Tier 1 and Tier 3 in the rest of the file.

The meaning is faithful throughout. The compatibility statements in [10]/[35], the Pauli-Lindblad vs TREX condition in [8]/[38] and the underscore vs hyphen note in [28] all survive intact, so nothing would mislead a learner. Three wording issues remain. "Directed execution model" becomes "modello di esecuzione diretta" in [7] and [43], which reads as "direct execution" and loses the idea of execution done as directed by the user. In [7], "unique layers" becomes "livelli unici", which suggests "single layers" rather than "distinct layers". Also in [7], "catturare l'intenzione progettuale" is a stiff calque of "capture design intent".

examples.source: [directed execution model](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.translation: [modello di esecuzione diretta](/guides/directed-execution-model)
examples.suggested: modello di esecuzione guidata (or: modello di esecuzione su indicazione dell'utente)
examples.why: 'diretta' means 'direct', not 'directed'. This loses the point that the server executes exactly as the client directs. The same rendering appears in [43].

examples.source: (for example, unique layers)
examples.translation: (per esempio, livelli unici)
examples.suggested: (per esempio, livelli distinti)
examples.why: 'livelli unici' is ambiguous and tends to read as 'a single layer / the only layers'. The intended meaning is non-duplicated layers.

examples.source: providing the pieces to capture design intent on the client side
examples.translation: fornendo gli elementi per catturare l'intenzione progettuale lato client
examples.suggested: fornendo lato client gli strumenti per esprimere le scelte di progettazione
examples.why: 'catturare l'intenzione progettuale' is a literal calque that a native technical writer would rephrase.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The benchmark caveats ([18], [21], [32]), the binary-to-spin mapping example ([51]) and the QPU-time claims ([15], [28]) all match the source. Three small slips remain. In [21], "Per il numero massimo di qubit considerato (90 e 100)" is a singular noun covering two values. In [56], the English Oxford comma was carried over into Italian ("aggiuntivi, e"). In [12], "La funzione ottimizzatrice" is a stiff calque. The terminology is consistent: gate, transpilazione, Hamiltoniana, stato fondamentale, post-processing and the informal "tu" register are kept throughout.

examples.source: For the largest qubit numbers considered (90 and 100), hardware noise degrades the optimizer result
examples.translation: Per il numero massimo di qubit considerato (90 e 100), il rumore dell'hardware degrada il risultato
examples.suggested: Per i numeri di qubit più elevati considerati (90 e 100), il rumore dell'hardware degrada il risultato
examples.why: A singular 'numero massimo' next to two values reads oddly. The English is plural.

examples.source: - additional optimization algorithms, and
examples.translation: - algoritmi di ottimizzazione aggiuntivi, e
examples.suggested: - algoritmi di ottimizzazione aggiuntivi e
examples.why: Italian does not use the serial comma before 'e'. This is copied from English punctuation.

examples.source: The optimizer function routes the problem definition to the Parity Twine Compiler.
examples.translation: La funzione ottimizzatrice instrada la definizione del problema al Parity Twine Compiler.
examples.suggested: La funzione di ottimizzazione inoltra la definizione del problema al Parity Twine Compiler.
examples.why: 'Funzione ottimizzatrice' is a stiff calque. 'Funzione di ottimizzazione' (or simply 'l'ottimizzatore') is more natural.

editor_note: All five rewritten entries are faithful. In [7], "L'impostazione `enabled` limita la visibilità degli utenti... non possono vedersi tra loro, anche se hanno accesso alle stesse risorse" keeps both the restriction and the caveat, and [21] renders the steps as "crea un ruolo personalizzato"/"il set minimo di autorizzazioni", which is accurate and uses tu.

None of the 12 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The precedence rules in [16], [18] and [21] are faithful, and the API link labels and [58] "reimpostare i qubit allo stato fondamentale" are correct. In [16], "un argomento parola chiave shot" is a word-for-word calque of "a shots keyword argument", and it also changes the literal keyword name from `shots` to "shot". Separately, [16] and [18] now write the invariable plural "gli shot" while the unchanged entries [17], [23], [24] and [30] still say "shots". This is a within-file inconsistency, and the new form is the better Italian.

examples.source: and a shots keyword argument
examples.translation: e un argomento parola chiave shot
examples.suggested: e un argomento keyword `shots`
examples.why: 'Argomento parola chiave' is a stiff calque. Changing the keyword name to 'shot' hides that it is the literal `shots` parameter of run().

examples.source: the order of precedence for specifying shots in the Sampler
examples.translation: l'ordine di precedenza per specificare gli shot nel Sampler
examples.suggested: (keep 'gli shot' and align [17], [23], [24] and [30], which still use 'shots')
examples.why: The same term appears as 'shot' in the rewritten entries and as 'shots' in the rest of the page. Italian leaves loanwords unchanged in the plural, so 'shot' should be used throughout.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful and nothing here would mislead a learner. The core terms are correct: "circuito quantistico", "misurazioni proiettive", "teorema di non-clonazione", and "stati quantistici non ortogonali" in the indistinguishability claim. There are two small wording issues. In the video title [3], "Dimostra come i circuiti rappresentano" uses a false friend: "mostra" is the right word, and the verb should be subjunctive ("rappresentino"). In [5], "deriveremo limitazioni fondamentali" and "ti guida attraverso il contenuto" [2] are a bit calqued; "limiti fondamentali" and "ti accompagna nei contenuti" would read more naturally.

examples.source: He demonstrates how circuits represent quantum operations
examples.translation: Dimostra come i circuiti rappresentano le operazioni quantistiche
examples.suggested: Mostra come i circuiti rappresentino le operazioni quantistiche
examples.why: 'Dimostrare' suggests a formal proof, which is a false-friend reading of 'demonstrate'. An indirect question after 'come' also reads better in the subjunctive.

examples.source: we'll derive fundamental limitations on quantum information
examples.translation: deriveremo limitazioni fondamentali sull'informazione quantistica
examples.suggested: ricaveremo alcuni limiti fondamentali dell'informazione quantistica
examples.why: 'Limitazioni ... sull'' is a calque. 'Limiti fondamentali dell'informazione quantistica' is the more idiomatic phrasing.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, uses "tu" throughout ("ti guida", "puoi aprire") and renders the terms correctly: "stima della fase", "trasformata di Fourier quantistica", "fattorizzazione intera", and "logaritmi discreti" in the Shor tooltip, which keeps the 1994 conference / 1997 journal dates intact.

Entry 4 matches the English and reads naturally in Italian: it uses "calcolo quantistico su scala di utilità", "simulazione di adroni e vetri di spin" and "modellazione della struttura delle proteine", and nothing is added or left out.

Both rewritten headings mean the right thing, but they break the page's own terms. Entry 7 translates the heading as "Utilità quantistica", while the body keeps the English term: entry 10 uses "noto come *quantum utility*" and entry 17 uses "dimostrare la quantum utility". Entry 42 translates the heading as "Calcolo quantistico", but every other passage and the sibling headings in entries 45 and 50 ("Il quantum computing in teoria/pratica") keep "quantum computing". Neither heading misleads a learner, but a native editor would make each heading match the term its section uses.

examples.source: Quantum utility {#quantum-utility}
examples.translation: Utilità quantistica {#quantum-utility}
examples.suggested: Quantum utility {#quantum-utility}
examples.why: The body of this same section names the concept in English, e.g. entry 10 'noto come *quantum utility*' and entry 17 'dimostrare la quantum utility'. With an Italian heading, the heading and its section use different terms.

examples.source: Quantum computing {#quantum-computing}
examples.translation: Calcolo quantistico {#quantum-computing}
examples.suggested: Il quantum computing {#quantum-computing}
examples.why: The whole page keeps 'quantum computing', and so do the sub-headings right under this one (entry 45 'Il quantum computing in teoria', entry 50 'Il quantum computing in pratica'). This parent heading is the only place that says 'Calcolo quantistico'.

editor_note: Entry 84 translates the heading "Post-process" correctly as "Post-elaborazione", which matches "Post-process (Post-elaborazione)" in [43] and "fase di post-elaborazione" in [85], so a learner would not be misled. The problem is that it no longer matches the other Qiskit-pattern step headings. The other three keep their English names ("Map" [44], "Optimize" [50], "Execute" [72]), and the body text refers to them in English ("il passaggio Map", "sezione \"Execute\""). That leaves the fourth step as the only heading in Italian. It should follow the same pattern, either "Post-process" or the "Post-process (Post-elaborazione)" form used in [43].

examples.source: Post-process {#post-process}
examples.translation: Post-elaborazione {#post-process}
examples.suggested: Post-process (Post-elaborazione) {#post-process}
examples.why: The other step headings stay in English (Map [44], Optimize [50], Execute [72]) and the list in [43] uses the pattern 'Post-process (Post-elaborazione)'. This heading is the only one fully in Italian, so the four Qiskit-pattern steps no longer line up. The meaning is still faithful.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: entry 4 renders the scaling claim as "quali fattori determinano la scalabilità degli approcci basati su algoritmi classici e quantistici", and entry 16 correctly renders "data processor" as "responsabile del trattamento dei dati", keeps the hedge "IBM potrebbe condividere" and uses informal tu ("Per emetterti").

None of the six rewritten entries (8, 54, 80, 84, 124, 202) would mislead a learner, but a native editor would change a few things. Entry 124 calls basis encoding "codifica di base", which breaks the "codifica in base" used in entries 0, 19–21 and 33. "Di base" also reads as "basic encoding". The same entry calques "shallower circuits" as "circuiti più superficiali"; the natural phrasing is "meno profondi". Entry 8 renders "complex data features" as "caratteristiche dei dati complesse", which can read as "complicated", where "a valori complessi" is unambiguous. Entry 202 writes "un QPU", where Italian normally treats QPU as feminine ("una QPU").

examples.source: This is different from basis encoding and amplitude encoding
examples.translation: Questo le distingue dalla codifica di base e dalla codifica in ampiezza
examples.suggested: Questo le distingue dalla codifica in base e dalla codifica in ampiezza
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 'codifica in base'. 'Codifica di base' breaks that and can be read as 'basic encoding'.

examples.source: methods that encode in product states yield shallower circuits
examples.translation: producono circuiti più superficiali
examples.suggested: producono circuiti meno profondi
examples.why: 'Superficiale' is a calque of 'shallow'. Italian talks about circuit depth as 'meno profondo' or 'profondità minore'.

examples.source: This could be extended to complex data features.
examples.translation: Questo potrebbe essere esteso a caratteristiche dei dati complesse.
examples.suggested: Questo potrebbe essere esteso a caratteristiche dei dati a valori complessi.
examples.why: 'Complesse' here is ambiguous: it could mean 'complicated' rather than complex-valued (in C).

examples.source: a QPU sporting a Heron r1 processor
examples.translation: un QPU dotato di un processore Heron r1
examples.suggested: una QPU dotata di un processore Heron r1
examples.why: QPU stands for 'unità di elaborazione quantistica', so Italian technical writing normally makes it feminine.

editor_note: Entry 12 (the Credly notice) is faithful and reads naturally in the tu register: "IBM si avvale dei servizi di Credly, un elaboratore di dati terzo", "IBM può condividere ... con le sussidiarie IBM e con terze parti a livello globale". Every clause is kept, including the data list, the permissive "può" and both privacy-statement links.

The rewritten heading [64] translates "Machine learning" correctly as "Apprendimento automatico", so a learner will not be misled. The problem is consistency: every other mention on the page keeps the English "machine learning". That includes the list of four application categories in [27] that this section heading answers, as well as [65], [76] and [81] ("Il quantum machine learning (QML)", "il machine learning classico"). Using "Machine learning" in the heading would match the category list and the section body.

examples.source: Machine learning {#machine-learning}
examples.translation: Apprendimento automatico {#machine-learning}
examples.suggested: Machine learning {#machine-learning}
examples.why: The page uses 'machine learning' everywhere else, including [27], the list of four categories this heading belongs to ('...equazioni alle derivate parziali (PDE) e machine learning'), and the section body [65]/[76]/[81]. Only this heading uses the Italian term, so heading and body don't match.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner, but three spots need polishing. "Utility-scale" appears two ways: "su scala di utilità" in [0] and "a scala di utilità" in [4]. In [4], "con un focus sulla costruzione di un calcolo" flattens "building toward" (the lessons build up step by step to that calculation) and drops the "but" contrast. "Corso in formato replay di eventi" is a stiff calque of "event replay course".

examples.source: on utility-scale quantum computing
examples.translation: sul quantum computing su scala di utilità
examples.suggested: sul quantum computing a scala di utilità
examples.why: [4] uses 'a scala di utilità'. The same term should be rendered one way in the file.

examples.source: but they are focused on building toward a utility-scale calculation
examples.translation: con un focus sulla costruzione di un calcolo a scala di utilità
examples.suggested: ma sono pensate per arrivare progressivamente a un calcolo a scala di utilità
examples.why: The Italian loses the idea of working step by step toward the calculation, and it drops the contrast between the wide range of topics and the single goal.

examples.source: This event replay course
examples.translation: Questo corso in formato replay di eventi
examples.suggested: Questo corso, basato sulle registrazioni di un evento,
examples.why: 'Formato replay di eventi' is a stiff calque of the English.

editor_note: Entry 32 is faithful and natural: "memorizziamo i numeri usando diverse rotazioni attorno all'asse Z". In entry 26, "precessing" is rendered as "che precedono". Some physics texts do use "precedere" for precession, so this is defensible, but in everyday Italian it reads as "come before" and a learner could stumble over it in a video title. "in precessione a velocità diverse" would be clearer. The meaning is otherwise intact: four qubits, different rates, used to encode digits.

examples.source: four qubits precessing at different rates
examples.translation: quattro qubit che precedono a velocità diverse
examples.suggested: quattro qubit in precessione a velocità diverse
examples.why: "precedono" can mean "to precess" in physics, but most readers take it as "come before", so the phrase is ambiguous. "in precessione" says precession clearly.

editor_note: The rewritten entry 64 ("5.3 Post-elaborazione") says the same thing as the English and would not mislead a learner. The problem is that it breaks the page's own convention for step names. Everywhere else the four Qiskit-pattern steps stay in English as labels: "Fase 1: Map", "Optimize ed Execute", and the matching heading 4.4 "Fase 4: Post-process" (entry 55). So section 5 now mixes English step names in 5.1/5.2 with an Italian one in 5.3. To match, 5.3 should read "5.3 Post-process", or else 4.4 and 5.3 should both switch to the Italian word.

examples.source: 5.3 Post-process {#53-post-process}
examples.translation: 5.3 Post-elaborazione {#53-post-process}
examples.suggested: 5.3 Post-process {#53-post-process}
examples.why: The matching heading 4.4 (entry 55) and the sibling headings 5.1/5.2 keep the step names in English (Map, Optimize, Execute, Post-process). Translating only this one leaves the step labels inconsistent within the page.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten headings would mislead a learner, because each keeps its acronym, but a native editor would still change all three. [11] "Autorisolutore quantistico variazionale" uses a coined word, "autorisolutore", that is not conventional Italian. Italian sources either keep "Variational Quantum Eigensolver" or write something like "risolutore variazionale quantistico di autovalori". [41] "Ricerca di sottospazio VQE" copies the English word order and reads as broken Italian; "VQE con ricerca nel sottospazio" is the natural form. The headings are also now out of step with the rest of the page: the intro list [5-8], the VQD heading [71] and the QSR body text [117] all keep the English algorithm names, so only three of the four algorithm headings are translated.

examples.source: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
examples.translation: Autorisolutore quantistico variazionale (VQE)
examples.suggested: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
examples.why: 'Autorisolutore' is a coined word that is not conventional Italian. The page's own list [5] keeps the English name, and so does the parallel VQD heading [71].

examples.source: Subspace Search VQE (SSVQE)
examples.translation: Ricerca di sottospazio VQE (SSVQE)
examples.suggested: VQE con ricerca nel sottospazio (SSVQE)
examples.why: This copies the English word order. 'Ricerca di sottospazio VQE' is ungrammatical as an Italian noun phrase. The alternative is to keep the English name, as the list in [6] does.

examples.source: Quantum Sampling Regression (QSR)
examples.translation: Regressione di campionamento quantistico (QSR)
examples.suggested: Quantum Sampling Regression (QSR)
examples.why: The rendering is recognizable, but the body text [117] and the list [8] call the method 'Quantum Sampling Regression', so the same method has two names on one page.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The CVaR definition, the alpha limits and the eigenvalue condition for cut membership all match the English. The problems are inconsistencies a native editor would fix. Step headings mix "Step 1/2/4" with "Passo 3: Esegui" (an imperative where the other headings use the infinitive). "gate" alternates with "porte", "mappatura" with "mapping", and "solutore SAT" with "risolutore SAT". "Hamiltoniana" (feminine) becomes "Hamiltoniani di Ising" (masculine) in [40]. There are also a few smaller slips: "assicuratevi" in [19] breaks the informal "tu" convention, the "References" heading [61] is left in English, and "line swap strategy" is rendered loosely as "strategia di scambio lineare".

examples.source: Step 3: Execute using IBM Quantum primitives
examples.translation: Passo 3: Esegui usando le primitive di IBM Quantum
examples.suggested: Step 3: Eseguire usando le primitive di IBM Quantum
examples.why: Steps 1, 2 and 4 use "Step" plus an infinitive. This heading switches to "Passo" and an imperative.

examples.source: blocks of commuting two-qubit gates ... We use a line swap strategy in this example.
examples.translation: blocchi di porte a due qubit commutanti ... utilizziamo una strategia di scambio lineare.
examples.suggested: blocchi di gate a due qubit commutanti ... utilizziamo una strategia di SWAP lineare.
examples.why: [15] and [51] say "gate" but [38], [40] and [46] say "porte". "strategia di scambio lineare" also loses the link to the SWAP strategy named everywhere else in the file.

examples.source: be sure you have the following installed
examples.translation: assicuratevi di avere installato quanto segue
examples.suggested: assicurati di avere installato quanto segue
examples.why: Uses plural "voi". The rest of the page addresses the reader with singular "tu".

examples.source: Trotterized simulations of Ising Hamiltonians
examples.translation: simulazioni trotterizzate di Hamiltoniani di Ising
examples.suggested: simulazioni trotterizzate di Hamiltoniane di Ising
examples.why: The noun is feminine elsewhere in the file ("l'Hamiltoniana di costo", "Grafo → Hamiltoniana") but masculine here.

examples.source: References {#references}
examples.translation: References {#references}
examples.suggested: Riferimenti {#references}
examples.why: This heading was left in English. Every other heading on the page is translated.

editor_note: Entry 64 is faithful and reads naturally, and its terms match the rest of the page: "la primitiva EstimatorV2", "backend fittizio" (as in entry 62), "circuito Trotter di riferimento" for "baseline" and "misurando l'osservabile ZZ per ciascuno".

Entry 7 is faithful and fits the rest of the file: "valori di aspettazione", "scansione di parametri" and "primitiva EstimatorV2" match the terms used in entries 28 and 49. Entry 38 renders "which sweeps the measurement basis" as "che definisce la base di misurazione". That drops the idea of a sweep, which is the point of the sentence. A learner will not be misled, because entries 28 and 40 say the angle is swept from 0 to 2π, so this is minor. Entry 38 also says "valutare ... a molti valori del parametro", which is a calque; "per molti valori del parametro" is the natural Italian.

examples.source: a single parameter $\theta$, which sweeps the measurement basis of the first qubit
examples.translation: un singolo parametro $\theta$, che definisce la base di misurazione del primo qubit
examples.suggested: un singolo parametro $\theta$, che fa variare la base di misurazione del primo qubit
examples.why: 'definisce' (defines) drops the idea of a sweep that the English states. The meaning survives through entries 28 and 40, so this is minor.

examples.source: evaluate a parameterized circuit at many parameter values in a single call
examples.translation: può valutare un circuito parametrizzato a molti valori del parametro in una singola chiamata
examples.suggested: può valutare un circuito parametrizzato per molti valori del parametro in una singola chiamata
examples.why: 'valutare ... a molti valori' copies the English 'at'. Italian says 'valutare per ... valori'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through and I found no drift. The penalty/clique/XY-mixer explanation in [17]-[20] keeps its quantities and conditions ("al massimo un estremo", "vincolo più stretto", "parametri QAOA ad angolo fisso"), and "cricca", "arco", "transpilazione" and "warm-start" are correct and used consistently. There are two small wording issues. In [53], "fine-tune" becomes "ottimizzare", which is ambiguous in a tutorial about an optimizer; "mettere a punto" or "regolare" would be better. In [14], "pianificazione" is used for both wireless network planning and scheduling back to back, which reads awkwardly even with "(scheduling)" added.

examples.source: To fine-tune the algorithm's behavior, see the Options list
examples.translation: Per ottimizzare il comportamento dell'algoritmo, consulta l'elenco delle opzioni
examples.suggested: Per mettere a punto il comportamento dell'algoritmo, consulta l'elenco delle opzioni
examples.why: In an optimizer tutorial, 'ottimizzare' makes it sound like the options optimize the algorithm itself, rather than letting you tune its settings.

examples.source: In wireless network planning, ... In scheduling, it models the largest collection of tasks
examples.translation: Nella pianificazione delle reti wireless, ... Nella pianificazione (scheduling), modella la più grande collezione di attività
examples.suggested: Nella progettazione delle reti wireless, ... Nello scheduling (pianificazione delle attività), modella il più grande insieme di attività
examples.why: The same word is used for two different application domains in consecutive sentences, and 'collezione' is a calque.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (15, 33, 39, 44, 52) would mislead a learner. The fault-tolerance caveat in [44] keeps its full meaning ("non scala bene sull'hardware rumoroso odierno", same small scale as the simulator), and [33] quietly fixes the English typo ("seguito dall'operatore di Grover"). There are two small things a native editor would still change. In [52], "near-term" appears twice and gets two different renderings, "computer quantistici attuali (near-term)" with an English gloss in brackets and then "algoritmi a breve termine". In [15] and [44], "we demonstrate" is carried over word for word as "dimostriamo", where Italian would say "mostriamo".

examples.source: give near-term examples of optimization with quantum computers ... For a more in-depth look at near-term algorithms
examples.translation: forniscono esempi di ottimizzazione con i computer quantistici attuali (near-term) ... Per uno sguardo più approfondito agli algoritmi a breve termine
examples.suggested: forniscono esempi di ottimizzazione con i computer quantistici attuali ... Per uno sguardo più approfondito agli algoritmi per i computer quantistici attuali
examples.why: The same term gets two different renderings in one entry, and the English gloss in brackets reads as a translator's hedge. Pick one rendering and use it both times.

examples.source: we demonstrate the hardware execution at the same small scale as the simulator example above
examples.translation: dimostriamo l'esecuzione hardware alla stessa piccola scala dell'esempio con il simulatore
examples.suggested: mostriamo l'esecuzione su hardware alla stessa piccola scala dell'esempio con il simulatore visto sopra
examples.why: Italian 'dimostrare' means 'to prove', so 'mostrare' is the natural verb for showing an execution. The same calque appears in [15] ('Qui dimostriamo come costruire'). The small word 'above' was also dropped.

editor_note: The rewritten entries keep their meaning. Negations, bounds and caveats survive intact, including the monotone variational bound, the $M_J$-on-products argument and the exact-vs-first-order angle comparison. There are a few editorial slips. "Shell" switches gender within the file: it is "la shell $sd$" in entries 52, 90 and 96 but "lo shell $pf$" or "un singolo shell" in entries 107, 118, 126, 160 and 167. "A few percent" is rendered as "alcuni punti percentuali" (entries 54 and 165), which reads as percentage points. "The reference determinant it improves on" becomes the ambiguous "che migliora" (entries 121 and 129). There are also calques such as "autovettore convergente", "vale più vicino a 2", "mezze registro" and "e eseguirla".

examples.source: Skipping this step changes the correlation energy by a few percent.
examples.translation: Saltare questo passaggio cambia l'energia di correlazione di alcuni punti percentuali.
examples.suggested: Saltare questo passaggio cambia l'energia di correlazione di qualche punto percentuale / di alcuni punti percentuali → "di qualche percento"
examples.why: This is a relative change, so 'qualche percento' is the correct wording. 'Punti percentuali' implies an absolute difference in percentage points. The same wording appears in entry 165.

examples.source: the run returns a rigorous upper bound and the reference determinant it improves on.
examples.translation: l'esecuzione restituisce un rigoroso limite superiore e il determinante di riferimento che migliora.
examples.suggested: ...un rigoroso limite superiore e il determinante di riferimento rispetto al quale tale limite migliora.
examples.why: In 'che migliora' the determinant can be read as the thing doing the improving, which reverses the relationship. The same issue appears in entry 129.

examples.source: The $pf$ shell above $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}$ has four orbitals per species
examples.translation: Lo shell $pf$ sopra $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}$ ha quattro orbitali per specie
examples.suggested: La shell $pf$ sopra $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}$...
examples.why: 'Shell' is feminine in entries 52, 90 and 96 ('la shell $sd$') but masculine here and in entries 107, 118, 160 and 167. It should be used consistently.

examples.source: Reorder the retained determinants by their weight in the converged eigenvector
examples.translation: Riordinando i determinanti mantenuti in base al loro peso nell'autovettore convergente
examples.suggested: ...nell'autovettore a convergenza (o: convergito)
examples.why: 'Convergente' means 'converging', not 'converged'. This is a small aspectual calque.

examples.source: in the $pf$ shell, it is worth closer to 2.
examples.translation: nello shell $pf$, vale più vicino a 2.
examples.suggested: nella shell $pf$ si avvicina piuttosto a 2 MeV.
examples.why: 'Vale più vicino a 2' is a literal calque of the English that a native speaker would not write.

editor_note: None of the 12 rewritten entries misleads a learner. The PEC gamma/gamma^2 explanation (15), the backward-bound caveat about the initial state (17), the ~3.4-fold reduction to gamma^2 ≈ 48 (150) and the speed-limit tightening (97) all match the English. The problems are small wording slips. Entry 62 renders "transpile" as "tradurremo", although the rest of the file uses "transpilazione" and "transpiler". Entry 150 says "circa ~3,4 volte", which repeats the approximation. Entries 72, 150 and 155 use "shading dei coni di luce" while entry 7 uses "ombreggiatura". Entry 155 translates the arXiv paper title that entry 17 leaves in English.

examples.source: First, we will transpile our circuit to ISA instructions
examples.translation: Per prima cosa, tradurremo il nostro circuito in istruzioni ISA
examples.suggested: Per prima cosa, transpiliamo il nostro circuito in istruzioni ISA
examples.why: 'Tradurre' hides the transpile concept that the file otherwise calls 'transpilazione'/'transpiler'. 'Informata da' in the same entry is also a calque; 'scelta sulla base di' reads better.

examples.source: SLC reduces the overhead a further ~3.4-fold
examples.translation: SLC riduce ulteriormente l'overhead di circa ~3,4 volte
examples.suggested: SLC riduce ulteriormente l'overhead di circa 3,4 volte
examples.why: 'circa' and '~' say the same thing, so the approximation is stated twice.

examples.source: Workflow for lightcone shading, noise learning, and anti-noise injection
examples.translation: Workflow per lo shading dei coni di luce, l'apprendimento del rumore e l'iniezione dell'anti-rumore
examples.suggested: Workflow per l'ombreggiatura dei coni di luce, l'apprendimento del rumore e l'iniezione dell'anti-rumore
examples.why: Entry 7 renders 'shading' as 'ombreggiatura', and the core term is 'coni di luce ombreggiati'. The half-English 'shading' here and in 150 and 155 is inconsistent with that.

examples.source: [Lightcone shading for classically accelerated quantum error mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04401)
examples.translation: [Shading dei coni di luce per la mitigazione degli errori quantistici accelerata classicamente](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04401)
examples.suggested: [Lightcone shading for classically accelerated quantum error mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04401)
examples.why: This is an English-only arXiv paper title, and entry 17 keeps it in English. Translating it here makes it look like an Italian resource.

examples.source: a user learns the noise of unique layers in a circuit ... tends to suffer from a higher overhead
examples.translation: un utente apprende il rumore di livelli unici in un circuito ... tende a soffrire di un overhead maggiore
examples.suggested: un utente apprende il rumore dei livelli distinti di un circuito ... tende a comportare un overhead maggiore
examples.why: 'Livelli unici' is a calque of 'unique layers' and suggests 'one-of-a-kind' layers rather than distinct ones. 'Soffrire di' is also an English calque.

editor_note: None of the 9 rewritten entries misleads: 117, 122, 127, 132, 136, 137 and 141 keep the source's conditions, quantities and caveats (e.g. "non è necessario fornire `refs_to_noise_models`", "primi 30 termini", scale "0.0"). Two phrasings would still be changed by a native editor. In entry 149, "L'approccio PNA semplice ripristina già il valore di aspettazione vicino al benchmark" is a calque: "semplice" can read as "simple" rather than "plain/unaugmented", and "ripristina ... vicino" is unidiomatic. In entry 88, "vengono assorbiti come dressing a sinistra" is stiff, and "assorbiti" adds an interpretive verb the English does not use.

examples.source: The plain PNA approach already restores the expectation value close to the ideal benchmark
examples.translation: L'approccio PNA semplice ripristina già il valore di aspettazione vicino al benchmark ideale
examples.suggested: La sola PNA riporta già il valore di aspettazione vicino al benchmark ideale
examples.why: 'semplice' is ambiguous (simple vs. plain/without add-ons), and 'ripristina ... vicino a' is a calque of 'restores ... close to'. 'La sola PNA' / 'riporta' is how an Italian writer would say it.

examples.source: Single-qubit gates are left-dressed within the boxes.
examples.translation: I gate a singolo qubit vengono assorbiti come dressing a sinistra ("left-dressed") all'interno dei box.
examples.suggested: All'interno dei box, i gate a singolo qubit vengono inglobati nel dressing a sinistra ("left-dressed").
examples.why: Stiff phrasing. 'assorbiti come dressing' is awkward and adds a verb not in the source. The meaning is recoverable, so this is minor.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The directional claims are all correct: two-qubit errors "al di sopra" the reported ones, T2 "ben al di sotto", the 56/53/142 µs medians, and the caveat that a gap "non è automaticamente prova di drift". A few terms are inconsistent. "Gate" becomes "porte" in [0] and [15] but "gate" everywhere else. "Workflow" switches between "flusso di lavoro" and "workflow". Curve fitting shows up as "adattamento delle curve", "adatta" and "fit". There are also some stiff calques: "layer" is treated as feminine ("intere layer", "layer disgiunte"), "non restituisce finché" in [91], and "hanno cambiato appena" in [87], which is ambiguous.

examples.source: one- and two-qubit gate errors
examples.translation: errori delle porte a uno e due qubit
examples.suggested: errori dei gate a uno e due qubit
examples.why: The rest of the file (entries 21, 22, 32, 57, 66, 70) uses "gate". Entries 0 and 15 alone switch to "porte", which is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: the extra echoes barely changed the result
examples.translation: gli echi aggiuntivi hanno cambiato appena il risultato
examples.suggested: gli echi aggiuntivi hanno modificato di poco il risultato
examples.why: "Hanno cambiato appena" can also be read as "have just changed". "Di poco" or "a malapena" says "barely" without ambiguity.

examples.source: The following cell does not return until all jobs and post-processing are done.
examples.translation: La cella seguente non restituisce finché tutti i job e il post-processing non sono completati.
examples.suggested: L'esecuzione della cella seguente termina solo quando tutti i job e il post-processing sono completati.
examples.why: Here "restituisce" has no object, which is a literal calque of the programming sense of "return" and reads unnaturally in Italian.

examples.source: over disjoint layers of the coupling map
examples.translation: su layer disgiunte della coupling map
examples.suggested: su layer disgiunti della coupling map
examples.why: In Italian technical usage, borrowed "layer" is masculine ("i layer", or "strati"). The feminine agreement here and in entry 22 ("intere layer") sounds off.

examples.source: refresh a backend with up-to-date T1, T2, readout, and gate errors
examples.translation: aggiornare un backend con valori aggiornati di T1, T2, lettura ed errori delle porte
examples.suggested: aggiornare un backend con valori recenti di T1, T2, errori di lettura e dei gate
examples.why: "aggiornare... aggiornati" repeats the same word. "Lettura" also stands alone as if it were a quantity, when it should be "errori di lettura".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the accuracy caveat in [75] (about 23.7 kcal/mol above the reference energy, chemical accuracy not reached) and the removed spin interactions in [76]. The only problem is terminology: the file uses the English loanwords in some places and Italian equivalents in others. It says "workload"/"workflow" in [0], [1] and [10] but "carichi di lavoro"/"flusso di lavoro" in [19], [34], [54] and [70]. The other problem is style: "il risultato si conclude circa 23,7 kcal/mol al di sopra" in [75] is a stiff calque of "finishes" and would read better as "si attesta a circa". Neither issue would mislead a learner. The tu register holds throughout, and qubit, transpilazione, ansatz and shot are used correctly.

examples.source: to manage IBM Quantum workloads and run a quantum chemistry workflow
examples.translation: per gestire i workload IBM Quantum ed eseguire un workflow di chimica quantistica
examples.suggested: per gestire i carichi di lavoro IBM Quantum ed eseguire un flusso di lavoro di chimica quantistica
examples.why: The rest of the file uses 'carichi di lavoro' ([19]) and 'flusso di lavoro' ([34], [70]), so these should match. [1] and [10] also use 'workload'/'workflow'.

examples.source: the result finishes approximately 23.7 kcal/mol above the reference energy
examples.translation: il risultato si conclude circa 23,7 kcal/mol al di sopra dell'energia di riferimento
examples.suggested: il risultato si attesta a circa 23,7 kcal/mol al di sopra dell'energia di riferimento
examples.why: 'si conclude' is a literal calque of 'finishes'. A native technical writer would say the value 'si attesta' at that level.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and would not mislead a learner, and it keeps the informal "tu" register throughout. A native editor would still fix a few things. "Transpile" is rendered as "trasporre i circuiti" ([52]), where Italian Qiskit writers use "transpilare". In [15], "evoluzione temporale dell'Hamiltoniano" reads as the Hamiltonian itself evolving; elsewhere the file correctly says "tramite l'Hamiltoniano". The linked SQD tutorial title is given two ways, "basata su campionamento di un Hamiltoniano chimico" ([10]) and "basata su campioni di un Hamiltoniano di chimica" ([15], [36], [66]). There are also calques: "è garantita essere un limite superiore" ([61]) and "Raccomandazioni" for the "Recommendations" tip title ([66]).

examples.source: we use Qiskit to transpile the circuits to the target backend
examples.translation: usiamo Qiskit per trasporre i circuiti verso il backend target
examples.suggested: usiamo Qiskit per transpilare i circuiti per il backend target
examples.why: 'Trasporre' means transpose/transpose musically; the established Italian Qiskit term is 'transpilare'.

examples.source: circuits that approximate time evolution by the Hamiltonian
examples.translation: circuiti che approssimano l'evoluzione temporale dell'Hamiltoniano
examples.suggested: circuiti che approssimano l'evoluzione temporale generata dall'Hamiltoniano
examples.why: 'dell'Hamiltoniano' suggests the Hamiltonian is what evolves; the rest of the file correctly uses 'tramite l'Hamiltoniano'.

examples.source: Sample-based quantum diagonalization of a chemistry Hamiltonian
examples.translation: Diagonalizzazione quantistica basata su campionamento di un Hamiltoniano chimico
examples.suggested: Diagonalizzazione quantistica basata su campioni di un Hamiltoniano di chimica
examples.why: The same tutorial title appears in entries 15, 36 and 66 as 'basata su campioni ... di chimica'. It should be rendered the same way everywhere.

examples.source: is guaranteed to be an upper bound to the true ground state energy
examples.translation: è garantita essere un limite superiore alla vera energia dello stato fondamentale
examples.suggested: è sicuramente un limite superiore per la vera energia dello stato fondamentale
examples.why: 'è garantita essere' copies the English passive-infinitive construction and is not natural Italian.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The Hamiltonian normalization note [28], the explanation that two-layer fidelities are lower [72] and the two-spinon continuum description [83] are all correct, so nothing would mislead a learner. Several things still need an editor. [19] leaves "quantum-magnet" in English ("esempio del quantum-magnet") and uses "diffusione di neutroni", while the rest of the file says "scattering di neutroni". [57] renders "shallower" as "più superficiale", which means superficial, not low-depth. There are also a few calques: "i primi diversi livelli" [38], "solo di circa $\sim 2.7\%$" with a redundant "circa" before ~ [25], and "Questo è previsto" [72]. The AQC sub-step list mixes infinitive headings with imperative bodies ("Calcolare… simula", "Assemblare… aggiungi").

examples.source: Its quantum-magnet example develops methods... / Neutron scattering helps researchers
examples.translation: Il suo esempio del quantum-magnet sviluppa metodi... / La diffusione di neutroni aiuta
examples.suggested: Il suo esempio di magnete quantistico sviluppa metodi... / Lo scattering di neutroni aiuta
examples.why: Leaves an English compound untranslated, and 'diffusione' does not match 'scattering di neutroni', which the rest of the file uses.

examples.source: producing a shallower "AQC + Trotter" circuit
examples.translation: producendo un circuito "AQC + Trotter" più superficiale
examples.suggested: producendo un circuito "AQC + Trotter" meno profondo
examples.why: 'Superficiale' means superficial. Circuit depth calls for 'meno profondo', to match 'profondi' used elsewhere.

examples.source: replaces the first several Trotter layers
examples.translation: sostituisce i primi diversi livelli di Trotter
examples.suggested: sostituisce i primi livelli di Trotter
examples.why: Calque of 'first several'. 'I primi diversi' is not idiomatic Italian.

examples.source: the interchain coupling is only $\sim 2.7\%$ of $J$
examples.translation: è solo di circa $\sim 2.7\%$ di $J$
examples.suggested: è solo $\sim 2.7\%$ di $J$
examples.why: 'circa' duplicates the ~ symbol.

examples.source: This is expected, and you can improve
examples.translation: Questo è previsto, e puoi migliorare
examples.suggested: È un comportamento atteso, e puoi migliorare
examples.why: Literal calque. 'Previsto' reads as 'scheduled' rather than 'to be expected'.

editor_note: I found no misleading passages. The meaning is faithful throughout, including the gamma-score, postselection-rate and shot-budget explanations in [61]–[76], so there is no semantic drift. A few surface slips remain. In [70], the coupling-graph "edge" became "bordo" (border) where Italian graph terminology uses "arco". In [14], "entangled" became "intrecciato", although the rest of the file uses "entanglement" ("porte di entanglement"). [56] has an elision error ("e estrai" should be "ed estrai"). The calque "payload nudo" for "bare payload" also reads stiffly.

examples.source: rather than assuming every edge is equally noisy
examples.translation: invece di assumere che ogni bordo sia ugualmente rumoroso
examples.suggested: invece di assumere che ogni arco (collegamento) sia ugualmente rumoroso
examples.why: In graph terminology an edge is an 'arco'. 'Bordo' means border or rim, which is the wrong word for a coupling-map edge.

examples.source: a Clifford "payload" circuit is entangled with ancilla qubits
examples.translation: un circuito "payload" di Clifford viene intrecciato con qubit ancilla
examples.suggested: un circuito "payload" di Clifford viene messo in entanglement con qubit ancilla
examples.why: The rest of the file keeps 'entanglement' (for example 'porte di entanglement'). 'Intrecciato' is an inconsistent, non-standard rendering.

examples.source: Build the deeper circuit and draw a random sample of its stabilizers.
examples.translation: Costruisci il circuito più profondo e estrai un campione casuale dei suoi stabilizzatori.
examples.suggested: Costruisci il circuito più profondo ed estrai un campione casuale dei suoi stabilizzatori.
examples.why: Before a vowel, standard Italian uses the euphonic 'ed'.

examples.source: compare the fidelity of the bare noisy state with the postselected state
examples.translation: confronta la fedeltà dello stato rumoroso nudo con quella dello stato postselezionato
examples.suggested: confronta la fedeltà dello stato rumoroso senza controlli con quella dello stato postselezionato
examples.why: 'Nudo' is a literal calque of 'bare'. 'Senza controlli' or 'non controllato' reads more naturally to an Italian technical reader.
